stl_checks.caveat: fill_holes closes simple holes only; self-intersections and non-manifold edges need a proper repair engine; this is basic mesh repair, not universal printability

channel_packing.caveat: assumes same resolution and linear (non-sRGB) data; sRGB handling and 16-bit maps need explicit conversion

sprite_slicing.caveat: grid slicing only; irregular sheets need connected-component detection; engine-specific formats (Unity .meta, Godot .tres) not produced
